$doc: How studio's first-party EDITORS look on the Plugins page (program DES-LEARN §2): one line and a colour each; the icon is <id>/icon.svg. scripts/build-editors.mjs writes these into each editor's editor.json (`description`, `visuals`) for crew's registry; studio falls back to them for a crew that predates the fields. A run plugin declares its own in its manifest.json.
